Australian PM Appoints Former Murdoch Executive to New York Post

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has appointed a former top executive from Rupert Murdoch's media empire as the consul-general in New York. The appointee is identified as a former "top lieutenant" and "former executive" of Murdoch's companies.
